question: What analogy illustrates how reflections appear in consciousness?
premises: A crystal that is clear on all sides can receive reflections from all sides.
Consciousness possesses complete clarity on all sides.
Reflections appear in a medium according to its clarity.
inference: Therefore, reflections from all sides appear in consciousness just as they appear in a perfectly clear crystal.
plain_english: Just as a reflection from all sides may appear in a crystal that is clear on all sides, so too reflections appear in consciousness, which possesses complete clarity.
